[CC not fable] GRAPH MCP DOOR is functionally already built — verified live: reads (query/neighbors/history/memory_query), goal_front, and scoped-token mint all work; every write already stamps an actor and lands in history. The ONE unmet clause is "refuse unattributed writes" — and that CONTRADICTS the 2026-08-27 BULLETPROOF-WRITES ruling (you removed the hard no-attribution refusal because it locked out legit memory writes). Building it re-creates that exact lockout (mastra + cc write header-only today). Recommend: downgrade that clause from REFUSE to LABEL — writes stay bulletproof, header-vs-token is already returned, and the auditor REDs a header-only write without ever blocking it; strict-token only after every writer holds a token (the credential migration). Holding the refusal build; full detail + the ruling ask are on the ticket, not here. Next unless overruled: close the wiki-render sibling (gridpane-mcp + the own-hostname sweep).

[CC not fable] 1042 CLASS — both dead workers now FIXED + PROVEN on their routes. wiki-render: www.abilifi.net/d/ renders (publish 200, read-back 200 rendered HTML). gridpane-mcp: just fixed the same own-hostname auth fetch -> env.AUTH service binding + AUTH [[services]] in wrangler, deployed; mcp.bebond.net/gp/health returns HTTP 200 with server=bebond-gridpane-mcp-server, the exact acceptance. Note on BOTH: the *.workers.dev surface still shows 1042 (that surface has no configured route / stale edge) — the live routes (www.abilifi.net, mcp.bebond.net) are the real ones and they are green. Remaining on the 1042 ticket: the account-wide SWEEP — a grep found ~12 worker source files fetching our own hostnames (identity, bb-chat, bb-repl, labtui, gridpane done, wiki-render done); each needs triage for whether the fetch is in auth-middleware (dead-class) or a legit tool call, findings per worker on the ticket.
